# netactuate_platform_maintenance (Data Source)

Reads a Platform Maintenance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_platform_maintenance" "example" {
  location = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `location` (String) Location to query. This is a string and accepts either a numeric location ID or an IATA code, for example 3 or sjc.

### Read-Only

- `active` (List of Object) Active platform maintenance events for the requested location. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--active))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `upcoming` (List of Object) Upcoming platform maintenance events for the requested location. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--upcoming))

Read-Only:

- `start_time` (String)

- `type` (String)
